title: TANICA PLC Framework Supplier Registration – Goods and Services FY 2026/2027
description: TANICA PLC invites qualified, eligible, reputable, and experienced suppliers to express interest and submit sealed bids for framework contracts covering 15 categories for financial year 2026/2027: industrial diesel oil, diesel fuel, transportation services, spare parts for vehicles and machinery, stationery, packaging boxes, security services, cleaning services, motor vehicle insurance, property insurance, fumigation services, wrapping shrink, PVC shrink water bottle labels, PET bottle preforms and caps, and tin cans for coffee powder packaging. Framework contract basis. Tender documents available in person at Bukoba, Arusha, Dar es Salaam, and Mwanza offices after payment of non-refundable fee TZS 150,000.

contact.name: TANICA PLC Procurement
contact.address: Bukoba HQ – Customs Road, Kafuti/Forodhani Street; Arusha – Makao Mapya Street; Dar es Salaam – NHC Road, Shekilango Street; Mwanza – Airport Road, Nyamanoro Street

eligibility: Legal eligibility (business registration, tax compliance, industry licenses), financial capacity (financial statements, turnover), relevant experience, compliance with tender instructions. Required documents: business introduction letter, company profile, valid licenses, VAT certificate, TIN certificate, certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association.
